boundaries: This measures observed native identifier infos; it does not certify exhaustive roots, runtime dependencies or deletions.
Prepared import-view contents are trusted externally; the receipt binds the view path and compared ilean, not every imported olean byte.
Module hints are first-owner metadata; typed names and const/fvar classes are retained without coalescing.
The module-wide coalescing comparison is diagnostic only. Promotions include legitimate aliases and are not counted as false dependency edges.
Fresh serial elaboration need not reproduce cached asynchronous alias decisions; the cached span and fresh native observations are compared separately.
Snapshot acceptance is limited to already-finished diagnostic-only trees; errors are propagated and unfinished/separate-info work is unsupported.
verdict: The cached editor definition range is not the declaration range. Fresh native info identifies local-variable binders there and the actual headCode constant binder at its own source location.
